covers: 1. AABB inflation (expands every face by clearance)
2. signed AABB distance (outside = Euclidean distance; inside = negative penetration depth)
3. face normal (single-axis-aligned, nearest-face case)
4. edge normal (diagonal between two axes)
5. corner normal (diagonal between three axes)
6. stopping-distance barrier accounts for inward speed (faster closing speed -> larger margin -> lower h)
7. static CBF inequality (n^T v_safe >= -alpha*h; v_e=0 for static obstacles)
8. multiple simultaneous obstacles (all within active_range are active together, never only the nearest)
9. 32-sided velocity polygon (inscribed in the true circle; conservatism ~0.058 m/s documented)
10. hard QP (succeeds when the constraint set is feasible)
11. soft QP fallback (engages with positive slack when the hard QP is infeasible)
12. emergency brake (both QPs forced to fail via a monkeypatched solver -> v_safe=0)
13. identity/no-constraint behavior (v_safe == v_nom, status identity_no_constraints)
14. route planner integration (routes around a blocking obstacle; direct shot when unblocked)
15. moving-goal replanning (replans when the asset moves past the 2.0 m trigger; no spurious replans)
16. no future target information (nominal velocity is a pure function of the CURRENT relative position)
17. C2 static-obstacle mapping (all map_known; static geometry bit-identical with dynamic obstacles disabled)
18. collision-free substep execution (ample-stopping-room scenario never penetrates the raw obstacle)
19. diagnostic fields (all Prompt-2 fields present, Prompt-1 fields preserved)
regression: route-planner-failure fallback keeps the previous waypoint, never the known-blocked direct target
